title: Infrastructure & compute
body: Run models and tasks within capacity, locality, and recovery limits.

title: Data platform
body: Provide trusted business data with ownership and access rules.

title: Integration & tools
body: Connect agents to existing APIs, events, and workflows.

title: Systems of record
body: Read and change official records through checked operations.

title: Business & industrial systems
body: Connect operational work while protecting physical actions.

title: Intelligence & learning
body: Choose models and evaluate changes in their behavior.

title: Agent platform
body: Coordinate tools, task state, recovery, and model calls.

title: Workplace & collaboration
body: Let people direct work and handle exceptions in familiar tools.

title: Experiences & channels
body: Deliver useful service with a clear route to a person.

title: Security & identity
body: Identify the agent and enforce the permissions of its task.

title: Governance & risk
body: Set accountability, evidence requirements, and data-location constraints.

title: Monitoring & cost
body: Observe quality, failures, and the full cost of completed work.

title: Operating model
body: Assign responsibility, supervision capacity, and incident ownership.

title: Data engineering for agents
body: Prepare, represent, retrieve, update, and remove usable evidence.
